value: This article introduces Zig, a general-purpose programming language and toolchain designed for creating robust, optimal, and reusable software. It emphasizes simplicity and predictability, eliminating hidden control flow, memory allocations, and preprocessors to streamline debugging. A key feature is its "Comptime" system, enabling powerful metaprogramming through compile-time code execution, type manipulation, and target architecture emulation. Furthermore, Zig offers exceptional C/C++ interoperability, serving as a zero-dependency compiler with out-of-the-box cross-compilation capabilities and a consistent build system, facilitating the incremental improvement of C/C++/Zig codebases and allowing its standard library to be exposed to existing C/C++ projects.
